summary: Hero civ where Jeanne d'Arc levels up with experience. Jeanne players go a deer opener into double stables, and level 3 Jeanne is their Feudal spike.
openings: Deer opener: a mill on deer, survival techniques, then wheelbarrow, 4 on gold, Feudal around 3:10, double stable.

spikes.label: Level 3 Jeanne
spikes.detail: Jeanne reaching level 3 is their Feudal power spike.
spikes.answer: Don't feed her experience. Defend and boom, or spear-rush them.

spikes.label: Knight raids
spikes.detail: Melee Jeanne leads knights and Ranged Jeanne leads knight plus archer, with constant in-and-out raids healed by Jeanne.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and towers at your resources.

scout: A mill on deer and double stables
Which Jeanne path they take: melee means knights, ranged means knight plus archer
howToBeat: Avoid fights that feed Jeanne experience.
Defend and boom, or spear-rush them.
